name: The Third Fleet
summary: Outside the Deepwater Tavern, First Mate Fitzsimmons drinks to drown his memories. He alone survived Kul Tiras's Third Fleet, burned off the Wetlands by red dragons enslaved by orcs during the Second War.

sections.title: A Sailor's Grief
sections.body: First Mate Fitzsimmons spends his days outside the Deepwater Tavern in Menethil Harbor, nursing a hangover and memories he cannot shake. He once served as an officer aboard the Wave Mistress, a ship-of-the-line that sailed under Kul Tiras's maritime banner. Now he trades those grim memories for dwarven mead. Anyone who buys him another drink can hear his account of one of the Second War's worst naval slaughters.

sections.title: Fire Over the Waves
sections.body: During the Second War, the Third Fleet sailed along the shores of Khaz Modan when fire came from the sky. The Dragonmaw clan had subdued the red dragonflight at Grim Batol and unleashed dragonfire on the unsuspecting warships. Fitzsimmons remembers helpless wooden hulls burning beneath towering flames, their crews dragged into the deep. He alone survived and washed ashore. His fallen brothers lie in the watery graveyard now known as the Doomed Fleet.

faq.answer: First Mate Fitzsimmons is an old sailor drinking away his trauma outside the Deepwater Tavern in Menethil Harbor. Once first mate of the Kul Tiras warship Wave Mistress, he is the sole known survivor of the Third Fleet's destruction.

faq.q: What happened to the Third Fleet?
faq.answer: During the Second War, the Dragonmaw clan ambushed and burned Kul Tiras's Third Fleet off the Wetlands coast. Orcs riding dragons rained fire from above, sending ships and sailors to the seabed.

faq.q: Why were dragons attacking human ships?
faq.answer: During the Second War, the Dragonmaw clan enslaved the red dragon Alexstrasza with the Demon Soul at nearby Grim Batol. Bound by dark sorcery, the red dragons were forced to serve the Horde as mounts and siege weapons.

faq.q: Where did the ships actually sink?
faq.answer: The charred wrecks lie beneath the sea off the Wetlands' western coast, north of Menethil Harbor. The area is remembered as the Doomed Fleet.
Fitzsimmons wants a flagon of dwarven mead to loosen his tongue and ease his splitting hangover. The innkeeper inside the Deepwater Tavern sells it.

faq.q: What nation did the Third Fleet serve?
faq.answer: The Third Fleet served Kul Tiras, an island kingdom whose formidable navy was the backbone of the Alliance's naval forces during the Second War.

angles.text: As a human, you can remember the Third Fleet's destruction as a bitter mark of the naval battles Kul Tiras and the Alliance fought against the Dragonmaw.
As an Alliance defender, you hear in Fitzsimmons's account of the Wave Mistress the scars left by the Horde's dragon-riders across Khaz Modan.
As a dwarf, you know Grim Batol cast a shadow over Khaz Modan, while dragons bred in its depths wreaked havoc on dwarf lands and human allies alike.
